model_name: HistGradientBoosting+sigmoid_calibration (tuned, v3 stellar params, + catalog crowding)
updated_by: restored after Stage 1 (TOI FA expansion) came back as noise, 2026-07-11
note: Stage 1 negative-class-growth experiment (TOI FA dispositions, +98 stars) confirmed no meaningful improvement (0.893 vs 0.903, mutually overlapping bootstrap CIs) -- reverted to the pre-experiment 5,491-row dataset and this model as final.
promotion_note: First deployed model change in the project's history. Added two catalog neighbour-crowding features. Validated at real scale: resampled delta +0.0166 over 12 training bootstraps, positive 12/12, clearing 12/12; nested CV 0.9222 -> 0.9298. Brier 0.0945 -> 0.0879, ECE 0.0441 -> 0.0417. Deployed by manual offline swap, NOT the live promotion gate: the gate requires production and challenger to share a feature space and raises ValueError across a feature-set change.
